note: Master glossary of the ZIN text sweep: every engine concept that vanilla text names, its Erdae term, per-people variants, forbidden words, grammar and capitalisation. Read by tools/content/lib/text_engine.mjs and by every module that writes player text. Terms are proposals unless status is D (decided by a Ready spec or an integration decision) or K (the vanilla word is plain English and stays). No vanilla sentence is stored here; the engine words listed under engine.words are single words and short phrases the scan must not let through.

statusCodes.D: Decided by a Ready spec, an integration decision or an adopted proposal
statusCodes.K: Keep: the vanilla word is plain English with no modern sense

slots.syntax: {id} or {id:modifier}; modifiers combine left to right, for example {division:p:lc}

modifiers.lc: running-text form: lower-case for common nouns, unchanged for proper nouns
modifiers.a: indefinite article and running-text form (an armoury, a host); proper nouns take no article
modifiers.the: definite article and running-text form; proper nouns keep their capitals
modifiers.people: resolve through the scripted localisation zin_term_<id> for the viewing country (country-scope text only); elsewhere it is the default form

slots.names: {name:key} inlines the in-game spelling of a proper name from tools/content/data/proper_names.json at build time; {loc:concept} writes the scripted localisation call [zin_loc_<concept>] of 02_lore/03_names_and_terms.md
slots.engineValues: A template keeps every engine placeholder of the key it replaces ($VAL|H$, [ROOT.GetName], @TAG, the colour codes it needs). The scan compares them.

style.spelling: British English: armour, defence, honour, favour, colour, organisation, centre
style.labels: Title Case for names and window labels; short articles, conjunctions and prepositions stay lower-case (Path of the Realm, Peace without Spoils)
style.sentences: Sentence case for descriptions; one idea per sentence; no exclamation marks; contractions are allowed in tooltips
style.voice: The realm speaks as we in alerts and prompts; tooltips are neutral; the chronicle never says you
style.numbers: Digits for quantities in tooltips; words for one to ten in descriptions
style.colourCodes: The engine codes keep their meaning: Y and H gold for names and values, G good, R bad, L grey-brown note, B and C links, O warning
style.glyphs: Windows-1252 only (CONVENTIONS); the typewriter fonts lack S with caron, so ZIN text drawn with them never uses it
style.reveal: Anything gated by the secret (Afrit, the Hidden Council, Eindil's name) goes through {loc:concept}; the glossary never holds it
